runway.flavor: a flat, mostly-open run-up stretch — clear flat ground so the player can build running speed for what comes next; keep it easy and readable, a breather between challenges

gauntlet.flavor: a platforming gauntlet — mostly air and platforms with little solid ground, a rhythm of deliberate jumps over gaps and hazards; a couple of gaps may be WIDE run-and-jump challenges (with runway before them)

cave.flavor: a tight, enclosed cave — low ceilings and narrow passages, claustrophobic, threading between walls and hazards

islands.flavor: scattered islands over a pit or water — hop from platform to platform, the ground below is a fall or a swim

climb.flavor: a vertical climb — ascend a rising stack of staggered platforms and ledges toward an exit at the TOP; occasional water pockets to swim up through
